description: A stair from a level up to the next: position = the foot of its first riser, at the middle of its width (plan mm); rotation = the way it climbs, degrees counter-clockwise from east (0 east, 90 north). shape straight, L (quarter turn) or U (half turn), turning left or right; winders: true turns on tapered treads instead of a landing. The riser count follows from the rise (default the level's floor-to-floor height) and maxRiser (default 180). It opens a stairwell in the slab above it. Check the footprint with capture_view mode "plan". Defaults: width 1000, going 280 mm.

position.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level
